description: Round 4 of the full-parity phase (callables family, seeds 9201-9215, 30000 cases): template names that are not valid UTF-8 (`template_from_string(code, name)`) in the `templateName` of an error (minimised from c9205-00691m, 4 raw cases). Harness item T15 (fixed): the oracle wrote the name as it was, and json_encode()'s JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE replaced the invalid bytes differently from twig-rs's lossy name; it now writes the name with put_string() (`templateName_b64`) and the diff compares the lossy conversion of those bytes, so the three minimised vectors were recorded again (twig-fuzz refresh). The controls are names both replace alike (kept from the first recording, without `templateName_b64`). Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".
